variants.label: A · 极夜全幅
variants.inspiration: 星穹铁道光锥：大画面与薄装裱
variants.direction: Cinematic anime collector card with virtually borderless full-bleed illustration, cool black-navy, platinum silver, restrained amber gold. Five elemental explosions form ONE dramatic connected spiral across the large upper illustration, atmospheric depth, elegant sharp luminous shapes, highly polished 2D anime digital painting with precise hard-soft edge control, rich cinematic shadows. Two fine off-center orbit arcs integrate with the illustration. A single elegantly cut thin champagne metal rail runs down the right edge; no ornamental classic frame. Bottom is smoky translucent midnight ink panel smoothly connected to illustration, ivory modern sans typography. Small high-class gold rarity marker and tiny five-point geometric seal. Asymmetric editorial title with understated English transliteration not allowed. An expensive futuristic fine-art print, restrained foil only on a few rails. Strong readable illustration at thumbnail size.

variants.label: B · 琉璃秘仪
variants.inspiration: 七圣召唤：完整轮廓与元素符号
variants.direction: Fantasy art-nouveau enamel and stained-glass spell relic card. Deep forest green and warm ivory, beautifully controlled antique gold framing formed from just two long sweeping botanical curves and a tall rounded arch, polished 2D painted craftsmanship, never a 3D jewel UI. Reinterpret the five bursts into one coherent beautifully illustrated luminous five-color ritual wheel on deep emerald with five tiny silhouettes, delicate line art and large translucent color fields. The curved arch and small open halo create a unique tall silhouette. Main frame narrow, gold highlights tastefully restrained. Lower reading panel warm opaline ivory with crisp deep green serif Chinese lettering, title sits on a smooth curved ivory band. Rich illuminated-manuscript art, botanical arcana, quiet luxury. Avoid dusty paper, grunge, heavy polygon bevels and pointed spikes. Make it distinctly softer, brighter and more lyrical than sci-fi.
